If Tx is 0x01, then the xth lights from the bottom is lit.  T5 is hottest, T1 is coldest.
                       T5  T4  T3  T2  T1
temeprature 1: 5AA5C018001E005C0000000001E680FF00800000000000FF00000000002300A907
temperature 2: 5AA5C018001E005C0000010001E680FD00800000000000FF000000000023003C98
temperature 3: 5AA5C018001E005C0100010001E680ED00800000000000FF000000000023007A99
temperature 4: 5AA5C018001E015C0100010001ED80DB00800000000000FF000000000023006B95
temperature 5: 5AA5C018011E015C0118010601E680BF00800000000000FF000000000023009B4F

The bottom 5 bits of RR indicate which rinse cycle is selected.  bit 5 of byte 3 is the rinse 0, bit 4 is rinse 1, etc.
                     RR
      rinse 0: 5AA5C000001E005C0100010001CF806D00800000000000FF00000000002300DBEA
      rinse 1: 5AA5C010001E005C0100010001E680DB00800000000000FF00000000002300EBBD
      rinse 2: 5AA5C018001E005C0100010001E680ED00800000000000FF000000000023007A99
      rinse 3: 5AA5C01C001E005C0100010001ED80DB00800000000000FF00000000002300BC71
      rinse 4: 5AA5C01E001E005C0100010001ED80EF00800000000000FF000000000023001095
      rinse 5: 5AA5C01F001E005C0118010601BF80FD00800000000000FF00000000002300F00E

The bottom 5 bits of SC indicate which spin cycle is selected.  bit 5 of byte 3 is the spin 0, bit 4 is spin 1, etc.
                         SC
       spin 0: 5AA5C0180000005C0100010001CF80ED00000000000000FF0000000000230054B4
       spin 1: 5AA5C0180010005C0100010001CF80ED00800000000000FF000000000023006490
       spin 2: 5AA5C018001C005C0100010001E680DB00800000000000FF0000000000230097DF
       spin 3: 5AA5C018001E005C0100010001E680ED00800000000000FF000000000023007A99
       spin 4: 5AA5C018001F005C0100010001E680FD00800000000000FF00000000002300F5F2
       spin 5: 5AA5C018001F005C0100010001E680FD00800000000000FF00000000002300F5F2

The bottom 5 bits of SO indicate which soil level is selected.  bit 5 of byte 3 is the soil 0, bit 4 is soil 1, etc.
                             SO
       soil 1: 5AA5C010001F00500100010001CF80FF00800000000000FF0000000000230001AE
       soil 2: 5AA5C010001F00580100010001E680BF00800000000000FF00000000002300D13E
       soil 3: 5AA5C010001F005C0100010001E680CF00800000000000FF00000000002300E404
       soil 4: 5AA5C010001F005E0100010001E680FD00800000000000FF00000000002300AF75
       soil 5: 5AA5C010001F005F0118010601CF80EF00800000000000FF0000000000230051DB
